title: Restricted Soil-Temperature Transactional Runtime Composition

runtime_contract.persistent_state: soil-temperature state is an optional substate of the existing committed physical state
runtime_contract.scratch: soil-temperature workspace is backend/worker-local and not persisted per column
runtime_contract.transaction: Richards and restricted soil temperature execute inside one outer checkpoint/trial/retry/commit-or-rollback transaction
runtime_contract.failure_semantics: a failed thermal trial rejects the whole physical trial including the successful Richards candidate
runtime_contract.restart: the existing polymorphic committed physical-state restart record carries the optional thermal state; no second serializer is introduced
runtime_contract.mass: water mass remains the authoritative water balance and excludes thermal energy; the qualified thermal process retains its separate energy closure
runtime_contract.hydraulic_dependency: thermal physics consumes semantic process hydraulic views and does not depend on HeadCalc internals
runtime_contract.time: generic numeric [t0,t1]; no day-boundary assumption introduced
runtime_contract.multiswap: restricted serialized MultiSWAP active/inactive isolation is qualified

nonclaims: no canonical admission is performed by F-MR39
no parallel-throughput or scaling qualification for thermal-active columns
no frost or latent-heat phase-change physics
no new soil-temperature science or formula change
no new combined water-plus-thermal timestep acceptance tolerance
no broader legacy soil-temperature option coverage
